entries.label: 2026 Canada employment amount (line 31260 base)
entries.notes: Lesser of $1,501 and employment income. Federal credit value = $1,501 x 14% = $210.14. No provincial equivalent except Yukon.
entries.source_note: taxtips.ca ($1,501 for 2026, $1,471 for 2025) corroborated by TurboTax Canada; CRA line-31260 page not fetched verbatim. Verified 2026-10-01.

entries.label: 2026 Ontario tax reduction basic amount (ON428 line 80)
entries.notes: Reduction = (2 x $300) - Ontario tax after surtax, floored at $0; cannot exceed Ontario tax payable. $554 per dependent child under 19 / dependant with impairment / spouse with disability (not modelled in playbook examples).
entries.source_note: taxtips.ca citing Ontario Taxation Act, 2007 s.20 and CRA Form ON428 line 80. Verified 2026-10-01.

entries.label: 2026 Ontario LIFT credit maximum
entries.notes: Non-refundable; reduces Ontario personal income tax (excluding health premium). Credit = min($875, 5.05% of employment income), reduced by 5% of individual adjusted net income over $32,500 (2022-onward rules).
entries.source_note: Government of Ontario official page. Verified 2026-10-01.

entries.label: 2026 Ontario LIFT credit rate on employment income
entries.notes: Credit is the lower of the $875 maximum and 5.05% of employment income.
entries.source_note: Government of Ontario official page. Verified 2026-10-01.

entries.label: 2026 Ontario Health Premium income threshold
entries.notes: $0 premium at taxable income of $20,000 or less; premium scales to $900 above $200,600. Collected through the tax system; not reduced by provincial credits.
entries.source_note: Government of Ontario official page, updated 2026-01-22. Verified 2026-10-01.

entries.label: 2026 Ontario Health Premium rate, $20,001-$25,000 tier
entries.notes: 6% of taxable income over $20,000 in the first tier (e.g. $22,000 income -> $120).
entries.source_note: Secondary citing CRA T4032-ON 2026 payroll deductions tables; threshold corroborated by ontario.ca. Verified 2026-10-01.

entries.label: 2026 Ontario LIFT adjusted-net-income phase-out threshold
entries.source_note: Government of Ontario official page (2022-onward rules: LIFT reduced by 5% of individual adjusted net income over $32,500). Verified 2026-10-01.
entries.notes: For a single filer with no spouse income, adjusted net income is approximated as gross income minus union/professional dues (line 21200). Family income is not modelled in the calculator.

entries.label: 2026 Ontario LIFT phase-out rate on adjusted net income
entries.source_note: Government of Ontario official page (2022-onward rules). Verified 2026-10-01.
entries.notes: LIFT = min($875, 5.05% of employment income), reduced by 5% of adjusted net income over $32,500, floored at $0.

entries.label: 2026 Ontario Health Premium tier-1 income upper bound
entries.source_note: Secondary citing CRA T4032-ON 2026 payroll deductions tables; first-tier range $20,001-$25,000 per the same table that sourced credits.ohp_tier1_rate.2026. Verified 2026-10-01.
entries.notes: Only the first tier ($20,001-$25,000 at 6%) is verified for this calculator. Tiers above $25,000 are not modelled; the tool discloses that Ontario estimates above $25,000 of taxable income leave out the health premium.
